A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A–D support reliable comparison; all six appendix pages are visually identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original training and fine-tuning results in Tables 1–2, value-zeroing experiments in Appendix A/Table 3, and empirical head-collapse and head-pinning analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including Tables 1–3 and the empirical analyses in Appendices A, C, and D.

M1.justification: The sink-aware auxiliary losses, shared/routed-head fine-tuning procedure, and Flash Attention implementation in Section 4.2 remain unchanged. No algorithm or model component is added or revised.

E1.justification: Training data, reasoning and long-context benchmarks, and appendix test scenarios are unchanged. The added PhyBench citation in Section 5.1 does not correspond to an added evaluation dataset or task.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Vanilla, Sink, and Gated Attention with base versus base+aux losses. Table 2 retains the same fine-tuning comparisons, and Table 3 retains the same value-zeroing conditions.

E3.justification: Model sizes, training budgets, metrics, and fine-tuning settings are unchanged. The appendices retain the 0.75 selective-zeroing threshold, 500-sample GSM8K head-importance analysis, and one-epoch head-pinning comparison.

E4.justification: The query-key geometry analysis, training-dynamics comparisons, value-zeroing intervention in Appendix A, head-collapse analyses in Appendix C, and head-pinning study in Appendix D are all retained without revision.

E5.justification: v2 adds no run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Existing plotted variability and raw versus EMA-smoothed training curves are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and the plotted results retain the same values and findings. For example, Table 1's 2B Gated base+aux average remains 47.70, and Table 2's Qwen3-8B base+aux LongBench average remains 55.38.

T1.justification: The implicit-gating identities, head-importance and imbalance definitions, auxiliary-loss equations, and Appendix B derivations are unchanged, including the near-zero first-token-value approximation for Vanilla Attention.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about native MoE structure, head collapse, and performance improvements from sink-aware load balancing. No contribution is added, removed, or substantively reframed.

C2.justification: Interpretations of value drain, query-key geometric constraints, collapse dynamics, model scaling, and head pinning remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility disclosures remain the same, including Flash Attention/LSE computation, model configurations, optimizer settings, LoRA rank 16, loss weights, and A100 hardware. No code or data access information is added.

R1.justification: v2 adds Qiu et al.'s PhyBench paper as a citation in Section 5.1 and a bibliography entry. The existing Gated Attention reference becomes Qiu et al. (2025b); other cited works and substantive research positioning are retained.

P1.justification: Section 5.1 changes 'complex reasoning ability' to 'reasoning ability' and adds the citation. The preprint footer becomes ICML/PMLR proceedings information, with limited text reflow and no substantive section reorganization.

P2.justification: Figure 2's caption changes 'across layers' to 'across models,' matching its model-specific panels. The plots and tables themselves are unchanged; publication information and the added reference cause limited page and column reflow.

improvement.justification: Figure 2's caption now better matches the existing figure and discussion, providing a small editorial clarification. The added citation, wording edit, and publication/layout updates leave the methods, evidence, proofs, interpretations, and reproducibility information unchanged, including all appendices. These limited edits do not meaningfully change the paper's overall quality.
